facts.fact: The Electoral Commission's ICT department is stated to run its ICT environment, on VMware as the core virtualisation platform, for which it seeks licence renewal.
The Electoral Commission's public mobile app was originally built in-house for the 2019 elections, with updates in 2021 and 2024; the date is the original go-live year, outside the three-year window.
The Electoral Commission is re-advertising for redevelopment of its mobile app, saying the framework is outdated and insecure.

SITA is inviting bids for maintenance and support of the server hardware for its OSIS and NMS environments, the latter used to manage network service delivery to its clients, and for VPN software for the Free State Office of the Premier.
